decisions.reason: The firm has publicly launched the anamnesis app as 'the new product line' on its own page, and it fits the announced digital, connected-practice direction, so commitment is high and weak early results would be read as temporary ramp-up.

The education institute builds on the firm's existing training content and supports customer retention, so its cost is low and its link to the core offer justifies continuing despite less visible commitment.
The remote screen-sharing support tool is a cheap complement to the firm's customer support and fits its push for efficient digital service, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
